That sounds like a really wise move. Since your therapy sessions have already been effective in helping you manage stress and navigate career challenges, it makes sense that the same support system could be valuable for processing these complex emotions around Alex.

It can feel overwhelming to hold onto unresolved questions about why things ended, especially when you're trying to protect yourself from reopening old wounds. Having a safe space with a therapist to explore those "what ifs" or to decide how much you want to engage further might give you the clarity you're looking for without having to carry it all alone right now.

Do you feel ready to bring this up with your therapist in your next session, or is there something specific about the breakup discussion that feels most urgent to unpack first?
